picks.name: Wallabee, Brown Interest
picks.why: Fills the empty Wallabee slot at 60% off, and it's the last UK 10 in stock. Earthy mixed leather and textile on a crepe sole: texture without branding. Wallabees run large, so stick to your true size; wear with the 502s or olive chinos.

picks.name: Chore Jacket, putty
picks.why: You own no utility jacket yet and this UK-made, logo-free cotton chore coat is 70% off. Putty sits in the stone family, so it works tonally over navy or olive. Layer it over a raglan sweat with jeans and trainers for photography walks.

picks.name: Regular Fit Stretch Chinos, fawn
picks.why: The cheapest way to cover the office trouser slot: a regular fit with real stretch, under target at £26. Fawn is close to stone and goes with navy knits and the brown Docs. Take the 31in leg for a clean break.
